Before you apply
What is a sports fitness certificate?

A sports fitness certificate is a doctor's note stating that, in the doctor's opinion after a consultation, you are fit to take part in a named sport or physical activity. The doctor may add a recommendation, for example a limit on the activity or advice to get an in person check.
A sports fitness certificate does not diagnose a condition. The note also does not approve your entry to an event by itself, because the club, school or organiser still decides whether to accept it.
People search for the same note as a sports medical certificate, a medical fitness certificate for sports or a fitness certificate for sports.
When might you need a sports fitness certificate?

You might need a sports fitness certificate when a club, gym, school team or event organiser asks for a doctor's note before you join, train or compete. The request usually comes with registration, and the organiser sets the rules.

Not every activity calls for one. The WHO says medical clearance before exercise is generally unnecessary for people without contraindications who start light or moderate activity no harder than brisk walking or everyday living. The PAR-Q+ Collaboration says that, depending on the condition, healthcare clearance may be required for a person identified as higher risk.
A different note fits better in two cases. For a general job or study fitness check, use the medical fitness certificate, and for time off because you are unwell, choose a sick leave certificate.

Which option should you choose on the form for a sports fitness certificate?

Choose the Medical Fitness Certificate option on the DrCertificate form for a sports fitness certificate. The form lists that option for employee and student fitness and good health certificates, and it covers sport too.
In your answers, write the sport, the event or club name and the date you need the note by. Mention any form the organiser gave you.
If no option fits, email care@drcertificate.com before you pay.
What will the doctor ask you for a sports fitness certificate?
The doctor will ask about your health history, any current symptoms and the activity you plan to do. Expect questions on the sport, how hard you train and the event date.
Share any heart, lung, joint or bone problems, along with past surgeries, recent injuries and regular medicines. Mention chest pain, fainting, dizziness or unusual breathlessness during exercise.
Honest answers make the certificate safer.
Recent test reports or a clinic letter can help the doctor decide. The doctor may ask follow-up questions in the chat, so keep your phone close until you hear back.
Where can a sports fitness certificate not be used?
A sports fitness certificate from DrCertificate cannot be used for submission in India, for legal purposes or for insurance. Applicants must be at least 16 years old.
The service is for suitable non emergency situations only. If you have chest pain, collapse or trouble breathing, seek local emergency care straight away.
Acceptance is decided by the recipient, not by DrCertificate. Check with your club, school or organiser before you apply.
What happens if the doctor cannot issue your sports fitness certificate?

If the doctor cannot issue your sports fitness certificate, you receive no certificate and the payment is not refunded. The doctor makes that call based on your answers and their own medical judgement.

A doctor may decline when your name and ID do not match, when your answers conflict, or when an online review is not enough. An in person examination or tests are often the better route if the organiser asks for an ECG or stress test, if you get symptoms during exercise, or if you are returning after a serious injury. An online chat cannot replace a physical check in those cases.
Payments are non refundable, except for a verified technical fault reported within 24 hours.
For help, email care@drcertificate.com.

The fee covers the doctor's review and the PDF certificate if approved. Payment goes through Stripe and is non refundable.

Acceptance of a sports fitness certificate depends on your employer's, school's or club's own policy. DrCertificate cannot promise acceptance, so ask the recipient before you apply.

blocks.text: Frequently asked questions about the sports fitness certificate
How long is a sports fitness certificate valid?

A sports fitness certificate is generally valid for 30 days in most South East Asian countries. Your club, school or race organiser may set a shorter window, so check how recent they want the note to be and apply close to your event date.
Can a sports fitness certificate be backdated?

Do not plan on a backdated sports fitness certificate. The doctor states dates based on the chat consultation and their own medical judgement. Apply before your registration deadline so the review date fits what your organiser asks for, and allow about 30 minutes for the review.
How is a sports fitness certificate delivered?

An approved sports fitness certificate arrives by email as a PDF, usually about 30 minutes after you submit the form and pay. Fitness cases are reviewed from 9 am to 9 pm IST Monday to Saturday and from 10 am to 8 pm IST on Sunday.
Can I correct a wrong name or date after the certificate is issued?

A sports fitness certificate cannot be corrected once issued, unless the mistake came from the medical team. Enter your full name as it is printed on your ID and check every date before you submit, because a name that does not match your ID can lead the doctor to decline.
Can I use a sports fitness certificate in my country?

You can use a DrCertificate sports fitness certificate in Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and Brunei, if the recipient accepts online medical notes. The certificate is not for submission in India, not for legal purposes and not for insurance.
Is my health information private?

Your health details go to the independent doctor who reviews your sports fitness certificate request, so the doctor can make a decision. DrCertificate itself does not diagnose, treat or prescribe. For questions about how your information is handled, email care@drcertificate.com before you apply.
Does an online sports fitness certificate include an ECG or other tests?

No. An online sports fitness certificate rests on a chat consultation and cannot include an ECG, stress test or other tests. If your organiser asks for test results, get them done at a local clinic or lab, where an in person check is the better route.
